title: Global configuration of various roboplotr outputs — set_roboplot_options
text: accessible Logical. Forces trace colors accessible plot background. artefacts Function. Control html file creation. Use set_artefacts(). axes Function. Control axis label parameters. Use set_axes() Note supported parameters global options yformat, xformat, yposition, xposition, xfont, yfont, y2font, xangle, yangle. border Function. Control plot borders. Use set_border(). background_color Character. Plot background color. Must hexadecimal color valid css color. caption Function. Controls caption defaults. Param template used stringr::str_glue() parse captions. Param xref used control caption's left anchoring, ignored robomap() robotable(). Use set_caption(). caption_template Deprecated. Use caption instead. dashtypes Character vector. Line trace linetypes order usage. Must contain "solid", "dash", "dot", "longdash", "dashdot", "longdashdot" order. empty_roboplot Function. Use set_empty_roboplot(). Control roboplot() without data displayed. font_main, font_title, font_caption Functions. Use set_font(). grid Function. Control grid behind traces. Use set_grid(). height, width Double. Height width roboplotr plots pixels. Use NA viewport size. imgdl_wide, imgdl_narrow, imgdl_small Functions. Use set_imgdl_layout. Controls dimensions fonts exports modebar. infobox Function. Defines appearance infobox info_text provided roboplots robotables. Use set_infobox(). labels Function. Control trace labeling. Use set_labels(). legend Function. Use set_legend() set legend defaults. Param tidy makes plot legend columns even width. Param xref used define anchoring relation either plot (default) container. linewidth Numeric. default roboplot() line trace width. locale Function. Defines locale parameters roboplotr needs . Use set_locale(). logo_file Character. filepath logo used every plot. Use "none" logo. markers Function. Control marker appearance. Use set_markers(). modebar Character vector function. Use set_modebar(), provide buttons contained modebar given order. Must contain "home", "closest", "compare", "zoomin", "zoomout", "img_w", "img_n", "img_s", "data_dl" "robonomist" order. override_webshot Logical. Overrides webshot screenshot function. Use want automate pdf file creation roboplot(). uses fine without. name Character. Saves current roboplot options defaults future calls set_roboplot_options(reset) roboplot(roboplot_options). patterns Character vector. Line trace linetypes order usage. Must contain "", "/", "\", "x", "-", "|", "+" "." order. rounding Double. Default rounding numeric values across various roboplotr functions. table_options Call. Use set_table_options(). title Function. Controls title defaults. Param include controls whether title included html. Param xref used control title's left anchoring, ignored robomap() robotable(). Use set_title(). trace_border List. Borders bars, pies markers. Values must named "color" "width". "color" needs hexadecimal color valid css color, "width" needs numeric. trace_colors Character vector. Trace colors order usage. Needs hexadecimal colors valid css colors. provide enough colors use cases, although roboplotr able extrapolate. xaxis_ceiling Character. Default rounding yaxis limit. One "default", "days", "months", "weeks", "quarters", "years" "guess". zeroline Function. Control appearance zeroline set using roboplot() parameter zeroline. Use set_zeroline(). zoom Function. Control zooming defaults. Use set_zoom(). verbose Character. roboplotr display messages, alerts warnings, warnings ? Must one "", "Alert", "Warning". shinyapp Logical. Makes fonts, css javascript available shiny apps. reset Logical character. Resets options roboplotr defaults defaults previously specified set_roboplot_options(name). .defaults Deprecated. Use name instead.
